description: Search every electric and plug-in hybrid vehicle listed for sale in the United States that Census tracks — new, used and certified, from dealers' own sites and manufacturer inventory. Returns matching listings with price, mileage, location, the dealer's own page, and the EV facts the site stands behind (battery kWh, EPA range, charge port, heat pump, DC fast charging), each marked estimated when it is not the manufacturer's own figure. Inventory is as of the `as_of` timestamp in the result.

heat_pump.description: Only cars known to have (yes) or not have (no) a heat pump. Cars where it is not established match neither.

mileage_max.description: Maximum odometer reading in miles. Cars with no stated mileage are excluded when this is given.

model.description: Model, e.g. "Model Y", "Ioniq 5". Punctuation and spacing are ignored.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging. Default 0.

price_max.description: Maximum asking price in USD. Cars with no real asking price are excluded when a price bound is given.

radius_mi.description: Search radius around zip, in miles. Default 100.

range_min.description: Minimum EPA range in miles (electric-only for a plug-in hybrid).

sort.description: Result order. distance needs a zip. Default: distance when a zip is given, otherwise price_asc.

year_min.description: Earliest model year to include, e.g. 2022.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP; results are limited to radius_mi of it and sorted by distance unless sort is given.

name: search_listings
title: Search EV listings
